class.name: OcgSelectmgrEntityowner
class.brief_description: A framework to define classes of owners of sensitive primitives. The owner is the link between application and selection data structures. For the application to make its own objects selectable, it must define owner classes inheriting this framework.
class.description: ! A framework to define classes of owners of sensitive primitives. ! The owner is the link between application and selection data structures. ! For the application to make its own objects selectable, it must define owner classes inheriting ! this framework.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Initializes the selection priority aPriority.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs a framework with the selectable object anSO being attributed the selection priority aPriority.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs a framework from existing one anSO being attributed the selection priority aPriority.

method.name: Priority
method.description: Return selection priority (within range [0-9]) for results with the same depth; 0 by default. Example - selection of shapes: the owners are selectable objects (presentations) a user can give vertex priority [3], edges [2] faces [1] shape [0], so that if during selection one vertex one edge and one face are simultaneously detected, the vertex will only be hilighted.

method.name: SetPriority
method.description: Sets the selectable priority of the owner within range [0-9].

method.name: HasSelectable
method.description: Returns true if there is a selectable object to serve as an owner.

method.name: Selectable
method.description: Returns a selectable object detected in the working context.

method.name: SetSelectable
method.description: Sets the selectable object.

method.name: IsHilighted
method.description: Returns true if the presentation manager highlights selections corresponding to the selection mode.

method.name: HilightWithColor
method.description: Highlights selectable object's presentation with display mode in presentation manager with given highlight style. Also a check for auto-highlight is performed - if selectable object manages highlighting on its own, execution will be passed to SelectMgr_SelectableObject::HilightOwnerWithColor method.

method.name: Unhilight
method.description: Removes highlighting from the owner of a detected selectable object in the presentation manager. This object could be the owner of a sensitive primitive.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the owners matching the value of the selection mode aMode from the presentation manager object aPM.

method.name: HasLocation
method.description: Returns TRUE if selectable has transformation.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns transformation of selectable.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Change owner location (callback for handling change of location of selectable object).

method.name: IsSelected
method.description: Returns Standard_True if the owner is selected.

method.name: SetSelected
method.description: Set the state of the owner.

method.name: Select
method.description: If the object needs to be selected, it returns true.

method.name: State_1
method.description: Returns selection state.

method.name: State_2
method.description: Set the state of the owner. The method is deprecated. Use SetSelected() instead.

method.name: IsAutoHilight
method.description: if owner is not auto hilighted, for group contains many such owners will be called one method HilightSelected of SelectableObject

method.name: IsForcedHilight
method.description: if this method returns TRUE the owner will always call method Hilight for SelectableObject when the owner is detected. By default it always return FALSE.

method.name: SetZLayer
method.description: Set Z layer ID and update all presentations.

method.name: UpdateHighlightTrsf
method.description: Implements immediate application of location transformation of parent object to dynamic highlight structure

method.name: IsSameSelectable
method.description: Returns true if pointer to selectable object of this owner is equal to the given one

method.name: ComesFromDecomposition
method.description: Returns TRUE if this owner points to a part of object and FALSE for entire object.

method.name: SetComesFromDecomposition
method.description: Sets flag indicating this owner points to a part of object (TRUE) or to entire object (FALSE).

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Set_1
method.description: Sets the selectable object.

method.name: Set_2
method.description: sets the selectable priority of the owner
